capabilities: capture commit snapshots with staging and unstageing of files
browse historical note versions and restore copies without switching branches
compare text files with read-only side-by-side diffs
manage Git branches, commit graphs, and ignored files
fetch from and push to a user-configured Git remote
extras: Desktop only; mobile is not supported. The README warns that Git history is not automatic backup or sync, that fetch does not merge files into the vault, and that merge/rebase and force push are not supported. Optional donation entry via PayPal does not unlock features; detailed user guide and feature overview live outside the README.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to track, inspect, or restore earlier versions of notes or manage Git branches from within the app.
summary: Git version control plugin that captures commits, browses and restores file history, shows text diffs, and manages branches and remotes inside the vault.
